label.description: Visible label and accessible name of the group.

onChange.description: Receives the committed value; 0 means cleared.

readOnly.description: Renders a static image with an aria-label instead of radios.

description.description: Hint under the stars, linked with aria-describedby.

allowHalf.description: Pointer, touch, and arrow keys move in half stars.

allowClear.description: Choosing the current value again clears it; Backspace and Delete clear from the keyboard.

showValue.description: Shows the word or number for the previewed value beside the stars.

valueLabels.description: One word per whole star. Five whole stars default to Poor through Excellent.

name.description: Submits the value with a surrounding form via a hidden input.
